title: Editor E0 task 14, email body writer: a node document is stored behind render_path_email
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20. lib/email-studio/layout-write.ts prepareEmailLayoutWrite is the single decision for saveEmailCampaign (admin) and saveSpaceEmailDraft (Space): a node document is sanitised by sanitizeNodeLayout(kind email) and stored as nodes only while render_path_email is on (fail-closed); a node document with the switch off, and any legacy save over stored nodes, still return NODE_LAYOUT_WRITE_ERROR before a write. render.ts sanitizeEmailRichNodes runs sanitizeInlineHtml over each placed and benched node's textarea fields by that node's own type. compiled_html is refreshed from the stored nodes (the compiler reads nodes since LIVE-877). No editor sends nodes yet (next slices: the email canvas editor on the node store, then the campaign load). Nurture saves still refuse nodes.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];const w=fs.readFileSync('lib/email-studio/layout-write.ts','utf8');if(!w.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('email')\"))bad.push('node write not behind render_path_email');if(!fs.readFileSync('lib/email-studio/render.ts','utf8').includes('sanitizeEmailRichNodes'))bad.push('no per-node rich sanitize');for(const f of ['app/(main)/admin/email-studio/actions.ts','lib/spaces/email-drafts.ts'])if(!fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').includes('prepareEmailLayoutWrite'))bad.push(f+' skips the shared write decision');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1057: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when an email save bypasses the shared write decision, a node write loses its switch, or node rich text goes unsanitised. Behavior is lib/email-studio/layout-write.test.ts.
